verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented data-export feature: no bulk or full-account export, no CSV or other open-format download, and no offboarding path. The only related material is a REST API with an OpenAPI spec, which is a developer building block for constructing an export, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
